picks.task: Task 1 consoling (~4 s) 'someone who sits with you'
picks.title: A loving father helps his son with his studies in the living room
picks.reason: Father sits beside his son at a lamp-lit desk and leans in to help; warm amber interior, calm, same-gender family, modest dress.
picks.concerns: Not identifiably Muslim; son's face visible (medium, not close-up); 'helping with homework' rather than grief, so it reads as quiet support only. Small 'artisan' print on hoodie (barely legible after crop). Same actor and series as t1_2 and t5_3.

picks.concerns: Not identifiably Muslim; daylight window on the right (needs grade towards night). Same series as t1_1; use only one of them.

picks.task: Task 1 consoling (~4 s) 'someone who sits with you'

picks.task: Task 2 phone (~2.5 s) 'a friend who calls'
picks.title: A man using his phone at home late at night
picks.licence: Coverr License (free for commercial use; isPremium=false, isAiGenerated=false, not a user-ai-generation upload)
picks.reason: A man alone at night in a dim room under a single pendant lamp, looking at his phone; wide, so his face is small. Good late-night mood.

picks.title: A young father supports his daughter while riding a bike
picks.reason: Father runs beside his daughter holding the bike seat as she learns to ride; seen from behind. A clear 'with it, not after it' metaphor: support while it is still hard.
picks.concerns: Daylight park, not rain or dusk (needs a strong cool/dusk grade). Father in knee-length shorts. Not identifiably Muslim.

picks.title: Family walking together in nature
picks.reason: A family walks a woodland path at dusk, the father carrying a child on his shoulders and holding the mother's hand; native 9:16 1080x1920 file (largest Mixkit offers), so no crop.
picks.concerns: Faces visible at medium distance and walking towards camera; married couple holding hands (family, but shows affection). Mother's hair uncovered. Not rain.

picks.title: Silhouettes of Women Holding Hands
picks.reason: Two silhouettes at dusk join hands and then embrace; faces fully hidden, dusk sky matches the palette.
picks.concerns: Mixkit titles it 'Women Holding Hands', but the right-hand figure could read as a man, so a romantic reading is possible: risky for the brief. Only 1280x720 is available (hashed contentUrl), so the 9:16 crop is upscaled 2.67x and will be soft.

picks.task: Task 5 listening (~2 s) 'Whatever you are going through'
picks.title: Two men talking
picks.licence: Coverr License (free for commercial use; isPremium=false, isAiGenerated=false, not a user-ai-generation upload)
picks.reason: Over-the-shoulder one-to-one between two men: the bearded man in white listens attentively to his friend (back to camera). Calm, same-gender, reads as being heard.
picks.concerns: Background is a clothes rail in a shop/wardrobe (not counselling-room warm light). Listener's face is visible, medium close-up. 50 fps (conform or use for gentle slow-mo). 1080p, so 1.78x upscale. A sibling clip (7129) has the men laughing; avoid it.

picks.title: Two friends talking in the cafeteria

picks.task: Task 5 listening (~2 s) 'Whatever you are going through'
picks.title: A middle age man teacher wearing glasses talking to a young man
picks.reason: A grey-bearded older man in glasses speaks gently to a young person seen from behind; reads as mentoring or counselling.
picks.concerns: He is speaking, not listening. Face close-up. Same actor as the father in t1_1/t1_2: do not use both in one edit. Listener's gender is ambiguous (curly hair, back to camera).

picks.title: Voxscape
picks.page_url_note: Mixkit music has no per-track page (track URLs redirect to search); the licence is read from this listing page's per-track schema.org entry ('copyrightNotice').
picks.reason: Ambient 'Voxscape': long sustained vocal-texture (vox) pad wash; no beat or melody line (0.05 hard onsets/s); 300 s so any 45 s window works.
picks.concerns: Mixkit lists a 'bass' instrument tag, so a low synth bass may sit under the voices. 'Vox' textures are synthetic, not a real choir. Check by ear that there are no words.

picks.reason: 'I Believe' (Religious genre, ethereal/glorious): smooth sustained pad with no listed instruments, very few transients (0.12 onsets/s).
picks.concerns: Genre 'Religious' may carry church-like (organ or choir) colour; confirm it does not sound liturgically Christian. 113 s.

picks.title: What it Takes
picks.page_url_note: Mixkit music has no per-track page (track URLs redirect to search); the licence is read from this listing page's per-track schema.org entry ('copyrightNotice').
picks.reason: 'What it Takes': the purest drone in the set, a single slowly evolving synth pad with almost no transients (0.10/s); calm, meditative, very quiet (-29 dB RMS) so it sits well under the VO and recitation.
picks.concerns: Synth pad, not vocal; needs gain. 298 s.

method: Searched Mixkit tag and discover pages plus the Coverr search (100+ terms). Built PIL contact sheets (~680 thumbnails). Fetched every Mixkit item page in the pool (473 pages: 218 Free, 255 Restricted). Coverr isPremium and isAiGenerated flags came from the page JSON. 360p previews were checked with 4 ffmpeg frames each. Music: crawled 335 Mixkit music listings (1,091 tracks, all 'Mixkit Stock Music Free License'), then checked spectrograms and onset rates.
